name: aws
description: AWS CLI v2 with enhanced performance, security, and SSO support

tools.description: AWS CLI v2 with improved JSON handling and SSO authentication
tools.usage:
aws configure sso # Setup SSO authentication
aws s3 sync ./local s3://bucket/path --delete # Sync with deletion
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=instance-state-name,Values=running --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].[InstanceId,PublicDnsName]' --output table
aws cloudformation deploy --template-file template.yaml --stack-name my-stack --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM
aws logs tail /aws/lambda/function-name --follow # Real-time log tailing

tools.description: Shell completion engine for AWS CLI commands and parameters
tools.usage:
complete -C aws_completer aws # Enable bash completion
echo 'complete -C aws_completer aws' >> ~/.bashrc # Persist completion
aws s3 cp<TAB> # Auto-complete copy operations
aws ec2 describe-<TAB> # Complete EC2 describe commands
aws --cli-auto-prompt # Interactive command building
